about: C4 leg states and the only transitions the outbox accepts (T13). 'submitted' is written BEFORE the provider call, with provider_id null; a leg found in 'submitted' with no provider_id after a restart is treated as unknown and looked up. Every transition is one row in leg_events, in the same transaction as the leg update.

allowed.on: about to call the provider (provider_id null)
provider accepted (provider_id set, provider status SCHEDULED/PROCESSING/SENT)
GET shows PAID (transfer), SETTLED (conversion, deposit, connected transfer); journal posted in the same transaction
provider rejected (ProviderError outcome=rejected) or GET shows FAILED/CANCELLED before any settlement
OutcomeUnknown, or restart with provider_id null
lookup by request_id finds exactly one object
lookup finds none AND the leg's last attempt was a timeout_before_send class or a restart before send; resubmitted under the SAME request_id
a later FAILED on a settled payout opens incident paid_then_failed; the leg stays settled and reconciled becomes false until the operator acts
dependency failed (a leg in 'after' failed) — nothing sent

forbidden.note: a failed leg is never retried; a new approval makes new legs

forbidden.when: lookup errored or found more than one

forbidden.note: nothing settles without a provider object, except ledger_only legs
a leg's request_id is set at queue time and never changes

dependencies.rule: a leg runs only when every leg in its 'after' list is settled
dependencies.demo: payout (2) waits for advance (1) settled; advance failed → payout failed without a call
